originalAlarm.description: Potential leak of memory pointed to by 'sc'

reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE: When SHARED_MODULE is false, the #ifdef SHARED_MODULE block (lines 11-13) is not compiled, so free(sc) is never called. The malloc'd buffer 'sc' leaks on return. KNOWN BUG: The vbdb entry for 2a6cbfa00e0.c documents exactly this MemoryLeak when !SHARED_MODULE — cleanup functions were only called inside SHARED_MODULE, which is no longer defined, causing leaks. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: When SHARED_MODULE is true, free(sc) is called and there is no leak. The presence condition SHARED_MODULE==false matches the known bug config exactly.
